regime_context: The detector shows Memory, HBM & Storage leading but fading, with Cybersecurity as a strong, broad, trending challenger—though crowded. Financials and Energy are trending, durable, and uncrowded. The validated absolute-trend gate keeps most top themes eligible, suggesting trend continuation but offering no return forecast; it is a risk-control lens in a market where gate helps drawdowns.
emerging_watch: Memory, HBM & Storage fading further: if it loses eligibility on the next update, it would confirm a leadership breakdown. Kill-criterion: if breadth improves to >0.5 and durability_bar moves above 0.7, the fade thesis is invalidated.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is the strongest challenger with high durability, clean trend, and full breadth, signaling robust thematic leadership that passes the absolute-trend gate. Crowding is a sizing caution, not a reason to fade, and the theme remains eligible.
evidence: crowded = true (z=2.22) – note sizing caution per guardrails
theses.dissent: Crowding could trigger a sharp mean-reversion shakeout; the theme could roll over if a macro risk-off event breaks the broad trend.

falsifier.text: If Cybersecurity loses eligibility (absolute-trend gate flips to false) on the next detector update, or breadth falls below 0.5.

theses.subject: Financials (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Financials is an uncrowded trending theme with high durability and broad participation, offering a cleaner trend-following exposure validated by the absolute-trend gate's track record of controlling drawdowns.
theses.dissent: Financials are sensitive to interest rate regime changes; a sudden dovish shift or recession scare could reverse the trend quickly.

falsifier.text: If Financials loses eligibility (absolute-trend gate flips) or durability drops below 0.6 on the next update.

theses.subject: Energy (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Energy is trending with decent breadth, solid durability, and no crowding, supported by the absolute-trend gate. Geopolitical macro backdrop and supply-side tightness provide a constructive coincident narrative.
theses.dissent: Oil demand is fragile and can spike lower on recession fears; breadth is only moderate, indicating less uniform participation than Financials.

falsifier.text: If Energy loses eligibility or breadth breaks below 0.4 on the next detector run.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
